title: Second BTC trade: full post-CASE-001 chain from Sep 8 through current long
scope_rule: CASE-002 does NOT begin at CPI. It starts immediately after CASE-001 closed and includes the entire Sep 8-11 learning/setup chain: sweep/reclaim work, divergences, failed breakout, deleveraging, capitulation, missed-short audit, edge research, CPI shock, reclaim, continuation, and squeeze payout.

position.entry_proof: At 08:53 the execution screenshot displayed a 77,613.3 position line, size 0.0191 BTC and PNL +7.3764 USDT; arithmetic against fair price 77,999.5 matched that PNL.
position.closure: NOT_CONFIRMED. Later screenshots do not show the position overlay, but absence of the overlay is not sufficient proof of exchange-side closure. Do not close CASE-002 until owner explicitly confirms.

timeline.summary: After CASE-001 was exited around breakeven, the analysis reset. Reversal candidates near dVAL/dPOC, a downside sweep, CVD recovery and non-expanding OI established the rule: sweep -> stabilization -> reclaim, not blind bottom fishing.

The market cycled through Price DOWN + CVD UP + OI DOWN buyer inefficiency, Price UP + CVD DOWN + OI UP leveraged sell absorption, then a failed breakout back below dPOC with OI collapse/long-liquidations, followed by deleveraging. This made path-dependence mandatory; endpoint matrices alone miss traps.

Repeated long-liquidation waves proved that liquidation size alone is not a bottom signal. The key research hypothesis became recovery efficiency: strong CVD/OI repair with weak price repair below broken value is buyer inefficiency and can arm a failed-reclaim short. The missed short was audited and long/short analysis became symmetric.
The failed-reclaim short edge paid off, then OI collapsed with price, showing deleveraging. This reinforced that the edge occurs at the failed repair, not after the move has already paid.

Headline CPI matched expectations while Core CPI MoM was slightly hotter. BTC wicked to 76,030 on the execution chart. The decision became whether bad news would be absorbed or turn into fresh bearish leverage expansion.

Price recovered from the CPI wick and reclaimed dVAL. CVD surged while OI stayed almost flat. This was higher-quality recovery evidence than prior leveraged bounces because aggressive demand was not dependent on a large fresh OI build.
The long reclaim path was validated by acceptance and continuation; ETH confirmed broad risk-on follow-through.

The recovery evolved from CVD surge + flat OI into Price UP + CVD UP + OI UP. BTC advanced above its 15m MA200 and ETH accelerated strongly. This confirmed participation but introduced a crowding test.

timeline.state: Price UP + CVD UP + OI DOWN
timeline.summary: The continuation shifted from leverage rebuild into squeeze payout. Price and CVD rose while OI contracted and short liquidations dominated. This validates the bullish direction but indicates that part of the move is being powered by forced short closure rather than fresh leveraged long demand. The edge was generated earlier at the reclaim; this is a poorer place to chase/add.

case_002_core_lessons_so_far: CASE-002 begins after CASE-001 exit, not at CPI; all Sep 8-11 observations belong to one continuous learning/trade chain.
After capitulation, compare price repair with CVD and OI repair. Strong effort with weak structural repair can be a short edge; efficient structural reclaim can be a long edge.
CVD surge + nearly flat OI + structural reclaim is high-quality recovery evidence because it is less dependent on fresh leverage.
OI growth is not automatically bad. It becomes dangerous when leverage growth stops producing proportional price progress.
Price UP + CVD UP + OI DOWN after a reclaim often means short-squeeze payout. It validates direction but is usually a worse add location than the original reclaim.
Separate signal generation from payoff. Reclaim/acceptance created the edge; later forced short liquidations are evidence that the edge is paying, not necessarily a new entry signal.
The short edge and long edge are mirror images: failed repair below value versus accepted reclaim above value.
Cross-asset ETH strength is useful confirmation of broad risk appetite, but it never replaces BTC structure and flow.
Raw screenshots are evidence events; canonical case numbering is based on actual position/thesis boundaries.

current_management_state.management_preference: HOLD/PROTECT rather than chase/add into the squeeze payout.
current_management_state.squeeze_read: CVD rising while OI falls and short liquidations dominate means the move is partly short covering/deleveraging.
current_management_state.bullish_followthrough: Best continuation is price acceptance above the breakout/pDay-high area while CVD stays firm and OI stabilizes rather than instantly re-expanding.
current_management_state.retrace_warning: If price fades after the squeeze and CVD rolls over, a reflex retrace becomes more likely even if OI is already lower.
current_management_state.crowding_warning: If OI rebuilds quickly after the squeeze while price no longer advances proportionally, buyer/leverage efficiency worsens and a failed-continuation setup can reappear.
